sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Procurement of Culinary and Ceremonial Grade Matcha

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (TW) — Investor Capital Origin and Cross-Strait Sub-State Jurisdiction; WFOE to be incorporated in a PRC municipality selected by the investor
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — PRC Civil Law (socialist-market legal system) governs WFOE incorporation, registration and AML/CFT; Taiwan Civil Law governs the investing company's corporate documents; cross-strait instruments are administered under the SEF–ARATS agreement framework
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA), signed 2010-06-29 between ARATS and SEF, in force 2011-01-01
Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement, signed 2012-08-09, in force 2013-02-01
Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Strengthening Tax Cooperation, signed 2015-08-25 (Taiwan ratification completed; entry into force pending exchange of instruments)
Agreement on Cross-Strait Joint Efforts on Crime Prevention and Mutual Legal Assistance, signed 2009-04-26, in force 2009-06-25
Multilateral: Both China and the Separate Customs Territory of Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu are members of the World Trade Organization (WTO)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Articles 1, 2, 98-103, 128, 156, 161, 172, 193, 203, 208, 387
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan; online via the MOEA Company and Commerce Registration Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of a Company Limited by Shares (股份有限公司設立登記申請書) submitted through the MOEA One-Stop Service for Company Registration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for a company limited by shares under current Taiwanese law; however, the capital amount must be fully subscribed and paid in by bank transfer or escrow account, and a Capital Verification Certificate issued by a certified public accountant is required for the initial registration filing
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the subscription of 500,000 ordinary shares of TWD 10 each be and is hereby ratified, and that the paid-up capital of TWD 5,000,000 be deposited in escrow at a licensed commercial bank pending delivery of the Capital Verification Certificate; (2) That the registered office be established at 12F, No. 88, Sec. 2, Zhongxiao E. Rd., Taipei City, Taiwan, and the Company be authorized to execute a lease and commence operations; (3) That the initial directors and supervisor elected at the incorporation shareholders' meeting be appointed and the Chairperson be authorized to open bank accounts and sign all statutory filings; and (4) That corporate seal and chop be ordered and an official company secretary be appointed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Approval and Trade Mark Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) - Online Name Reservation System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a reserved company name application to the MOEA Business Name Pre-Approval portal. Verify that the proposed English name, Mandarin name, and affiliated trademark for organic matcha products do not conflict with existing registered companies or registered trademarks in Classes 30 and 35 of the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office (TIPO) database. Pay TWD 300 per name reservation and submit proof of identity and proposed business scope.
required_dossiers: Completed company name reservation application form
Photo identification of applicant shareholder or authorized agent
Proposed company English and Mandarin name list
Business scope description matching ISIC 4631
Registered trademark search report (recommended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected for similarity, within 7 days submit an administrative appeal to the MOEA along with a revised name list and a written comparison with the cited conflicting mark; if rejected due to trademark conflict, amend the proposed name and re-file the reservation to preserve priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Incorporation Documents and Shareholder Subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public / Taiwan Taipei District Court-certified Notary Officer and international law firm
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Articles of Incorporation, subscriber lists, and stockholders' meeting minutes before a Taiwan notary public or overseas office of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office for notarization of signatures. The foreign corporate shareholder must provide apostilled or consular-certified certificate of incorporation, board resolution authorizing formation of the Taiwan WFOE, and power of attorney designating the local agent. All documents in Mandarin must be accompanied by notarized translations. The initial paid-up capital must be deposited into a temporary escrow account maintained by the Taiwan legal counsel before the Capital Verification Certificate is issued.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Subscriber list with share allocations
Minutes of the incorporation shareholders' meeting
Certificate of incorporation of parent entity with apostille/consular legalization
Board resolution of the foreign parent authorizing the Taiwan branch/subsidiary formation
Power of attorney appointing the local Taiwan incorporation agent
Passport copies of all individual directors, supervisors, and the local agent
Bank escrow deposit certificate or remittance receipt for paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Taiwan registry rejects the notarized documents due to defective legalization, obtain a supplemental apostille certificate or re-notarization from the original competent authority and resubmit within 15 days; if the shareholder resolution lacks specificity, obtain a curative parent board resolution and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: CPA Capital Verification and Bank Account Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) licensed in Taiwan and a licensed commercial bank in Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Taiwan CPA to verify the deposit of the paid-up capital in the escrow bank account. The CPA will examine the bank deposit certificate, escrow agreement, and subscriber payment records, then issue the Capital Verification Certificate (資本額查核報告書). Concurrently open the corporate operating bank account at a Taiwanese commercial bank after obtaining the preliminary company registration certificate, company chop, and resolution of the board of directors.
required_dossiers: Escrow account bank deposit certificate
CPA capital verification engagement letter
Bank overseas remittance receipt from parent company
Company chop/company seal specimen
Directors' identification documents
Articles of Incorporation and shareholders' resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CPA declines to issue the certificate due to incomplete remittance documentation, request the parent company to provide a SWIFT transfer confirmation and corrected escrow statement and reissue the verification letter; if the bank rejects account opening for compliance reasons, provide enhanced beneficial ownership declarations and re-apply with the same CPA verification in support.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Issuance of Company Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan Company Registration Office, Taipei Branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed incorporation registration package electronically or by physical submission to the MOEA Department of Commerce One-Stop Registration Window. The filing must include the application form, articles of incorporation, shareholders' meeting minutes, board meeting minutes, CPA capital verification certificate, lease agreement for the registered office, consent of the landlord, and corporate seal registration form. Upon successful examination, the MOEA issues the Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書) and assigns the unified business tax number (統一編號).
required_dossiers: Duly completed incorporation application form
Original incorporation registration fee receipt (TWD 3,000 approximately USD 100)
Articles of Incorporation and all minutes
CPA Capital Verification Certificate
Registered office lease agreement and landlord ID copy / consent
Corporate seal/chop registration card
Copy of pre-approval name certificate
Directors' and supervisor's consent letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MOEA issues a deficiency notice, cure the identified defect within the required 15-day administrative period by submitting supplementary documents or amending the articles; if the defect relates to capital verification, obtain a revised CPA certificate and resubmit the application with the corrected content.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: National Tax Registration, VAT and Unified Business Number Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of Taipei (Ministry of Finance, Taiwan)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the newly incorporated WFOE with the National Taxation Bureau by filing the tax registration application with the company registration certificate and corporate seal. Receive the Unified Business Number (統一編號) and certificate of tax registration. Apply for the VAT tax identification and, as applicable, 5% business tax certificate of registration. The taxpayer must also establish accounting books and invoice controls prior to first trading.
required_dossiers: MOEA Company Registration Certificate
Company incorporation constitutional documents
Corporate seal/chop
Director identification and legal representative ID
Tax registration application form
Registered office lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax registration is delayed or queried due to missing documents, file the supplementary statement and annexes within 10 days to avoid penalty; if the business tax application requires an actual premises inspection, coordinate a site visit with the local tax bureau and ensure the registered office has normal signage and operational substance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bureau of Labor Insurance (BLI), Ministry of Labor, Taiwan, and Local Health Insurance Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the WFOE as an employer with the Bureau of Labor Insurance for employees' labor insurance and pension funds, and complete National Health Insurance employer registration. File employees' identity data, wages schedules, and the employer registration form within 10 days after hiring the first employee. Ensure compliance with the Labor Standards Act for foreign-invested employer entities.
required_dossiers: Employer registration application form
Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number
Company seal and authorized agent identification
Employee roster, nationality documents, and employment contracts
Wage schedule and pension fund allocation table
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the BLI registration is questioned regarding employment contracts, submit corrected employment agreements and a supplementary wage report; if registration is rejected due to statutory incompleteness, cure by submitting the amended employee roster and re-file without delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Import-Export Trader and Customs Registration for Food Product Import
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bureau of Foreign Trade (BOFT), Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan, and Taipei Customs, Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the Bureau of Foreign Trade for the Importer/Exporter Business Registration certificate (出進口廠商登記) enabling the company to conduct wholesale procurement and cross-border distribution of matcha powder. Accept import/export authorization and receive the customs registration code (統一編號-based). For international trade of organic matcha, verify that customs procedures comply with the Precise Food Import Control Rules and register the company's customs broker.
required_dossiers: Importer/Exporter Registration application form
Company Registration Certificate
Unified Business Number tax registration certificate
Corporate seal and legal representative ID
Business scope declaration confirming ISIC 4631 wholesale procurement and distribution
Power of attorney for customs broker (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the BOFT registration is rejected due to business scope limitations, amend the articles of incorporation and register the expanded import/export scope with the Company Registry first; if customs registration fails for missing tariff classification, provide Product Classification Decisions under HS 0902.10 and re-submit to Taipei Customs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (not applicable to pure wholesale trade; food contact and physical storage only)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Import Permit for Food Products under the Act Governing Food Safety and Sanitation (食品安全衛生管理法) and the Organic Food Import Certification issued by the Council of Agriculture, Taiwan (subsidiary to scope of wholesale trade)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (EPA), Taiwan - Department of Environmental Sanitation and Pollution Prevention
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Registered Wholesale Distribution without Physical Manufacturing or Significant Discharge
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No statutory wastewater discharge threshold for matcha powder wholesale warehousing under Water Pollution Control Act permit thresholds; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions limits under Air Pollution Control Act Article 20 must not exceed 0.5 kg/hr from ventilation systems; solid waste handling must comply with Waste Management Act Chapter 4 requiring segregated collection and disposal contracts with licensed waste carriers for any contaminated product.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Required. Submit an Occupancy Permit and fire safety inspection certificate from the local fire department covering the registered office and warehouse; obtain a warehousing safety clearance certificate verifying structural load, aisle width, ventilation for matcha powder storage, and emergency exits, and carry out a workplace health and safety hazard assessment under the Occupational Safety and Health Act before employee stationing.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (国家税务总局, STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic taxpayer portal at etax.chinatax.gov.cn (provincial e-taxation platforms).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The WFOE automatically obtains a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) from the State Administration for Market Regulation upon incorporation; the USCC serves as the VAT and corporate income tax registration number. The WFOE must complete tax registration with the competent STA branch within 30 days of issuance of the business license. For non-resident foreign entities without a PRC registration, the STA assigns a separate tax identification number upon registration for withholding duties, permanent establishment filing, or treaty benefit application.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: PRC law does not provide check-the-box or hybrid mismatch classification elections for WFOEs; a WFOE is mandatorily treated as a Chinese resident enterprise taxed on worldwide income at 25% corporate income tax. With respect to VAT, a small-scale taxpayer may elect general taxpayer status even below the RMB 5 million mandatory threshold, which is a prerequisite for export zero-rating and refund claims. Treaty benefits on inbound dividends, interest, and royalties must be elected separately via the STA treaty relief application form.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (中华人民共和国增值税)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for initial tax registration; mandatory VAT general taxpayer registration is triggered when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000. Below this threshold, the taxpayer may remain a small-scale taxpayer with a simplified rate and quarterly filing. Even without revenue, the WFOE must complete tax registration within 30 days of incorporation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices, including fully digital electronic invoices (全电发票), must be issued through the STA's Golden Tax IV electronic invoice platform (电子发票服务平台). Invoices are transmitted to the tax authority in real time, carry an encrypted digital fiscal seal, and are reconciled through the nationwide invoice verification system. No third-party API clearance model is permitted for standard VAT invoices; mandatory tax control equipment (税控盘) or digital e-invoice access is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A WFOE registered as a VAT general taxpayer may apply the 0% export VAT rate where it is the exporter of record and the goods physically leave mainland China, including exports to Taiwan by sea or air. For organic matcha powder trade, the supply must be evidenced by customs export declarations showing the PRC port as origin and Taiwan as destination, with sales proceeds ultimately collected from the overseas buyer. Service exports qualify only if the recipient is outside mainland China and the service is rendered and consumed offshore.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or erroneous export zero-rating claims trigger retrospective VAT refund clawback plus a penalty of 50% to 500% of the refunded amount under PRC tax administration rules. Failure to repatriate foreign exchange within the 180-day deadline reverses the zero-rating and recharacterizes the supply as a taxable domestic sale. Criminal liability applies under the Criminal Law for falsifying VAT invoices or fraudulently obtaining export tax refunds, with potential imprisonment up to life and substantial fines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE, 国家外汇管理局) acting under the People's Bank of China (PBOC, 中国人民银行). SAFE holds exclusive authority over cross-border RMB convertibility, capital account registration, trade settlement verification, and FX hedging approvals; the National Administration of Financial Regulation (NAFR) performs prudential licensing and banking supervision; PBOC is the ultimate monetary authority and operator of CIPS (Cross-Border Interbank Payment System) clearing rails for RMB settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMB is fully convertible on the current account for genuine goods trade only after the remitting bank completes the 'real transaction background' check; dividend/profit remittance by the WFOE to its Taiwan shareholder is lawful once the bank verifies (i) Chinese CPA-audited financial statements, (ii) a valid board resolution declaring the dividend, (iii) the tax authority-issued certificate of tax completion under the Cross-Strait taxation arrangement, and (iv) the annual FIE foreign debt/equity registration declaration (FDI存量权益登记). Capital account convertibility remains controlled: the Taiwan shareholder's equity injection requires prior SAFE FDI registration, is held in a dedicated foreign-currency capital account (外汇资本金账户), and its RMB conversion/use is restricted against the national Negative List; proceeds may not be deployed for securities investment, non-operational loans, or real estate outside the approved business scope. The reduced 5% dividend withholding rate under the Cross-Strait Double Taxation Agreement applies only where the Taiwan parent holds at least 25% of equity and obtains a Taiwan tax-residency certificate (居住者证明).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The mandatory surrender/conversion ratio for export receipts was abolished by SAFE Circular 汇发〔2012〕38号; no statutory conversion ratio currently applies and the WFOE may voluntarily retain foreign currency or convert to RMB. However, export proceeds from organic matcha powder sales must be repatriated into the domestic goods-trade foreign-currency account within 180 days from the customs export declaration date under SAFE Circular 汇发〔2019〕28号, and each receipt must be recorded in the Goods Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System (货物贸易外汇监测系统) against the corresponding customs declaration. A newly registered exporter is classified as 'Class A' and enjoys simplified verification; late repatriation, mismatches between customs values and payment values, or related-party price deviations trigger downgrade to Class B/C, which imposes per-transaction documentary review and restricts FX hedging permissions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of China Limited (中国银行, BOC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign-Currency Capital Account (外汇资本金账户) + RMB Basic Deposit Account (基本存款账户) + Goods-Trade Forex Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (中国工商银行, ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign-Currency Capital Account + RMB Basic Deposit Account + Goods-Trade Forex Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd. (招商银行, CMB)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign-Currency Capital Account + RMB Basic Deposit Account + Goods-Trade Forex Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: China Construction Bank Corporation (中国建设银行, CCB)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account + Goods-Trade Forex Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Agricultural Bank of China Limited (中国农业银行, ABC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account + Goods-Trade Forex Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Communications Co., Ltd. (交通银行, BOCOM)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account + Goods-Trade Forex Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as any primary treasury or clearing rail: offshore digital EMI licenses (Hong Kong MSO/SVF, UK FCA EMI, EU/Lithuania EMI) confer no right to open domestic settlement accounts, clear RMB, or carry out cross-border payment activities inside China without a PBOC payment institution license (支付业务许可证) or SAFE-specific cross-border payment institution approval. Such EMIs can only serve as ancillary collection points for small-value receipts; the WFOE must maintain its primary banking and clearing relationship with a licensed onshore commercial bank, and routing trade flows through unlicensed aggregators on the China-Taiwan corridor creates criminal AML and SAFE violation exposure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for initial account opening: the legal representative of the WFOE must appear in person at the chosen bank branch in mainland China with the original business license, SAFE/digital EIA filing receipt, company seals, and passport; if the legal representative is a Taiwan resident, identity documents must be notarized and verified through the applicable cross-strait notarization and authentication channel (海峡两岸公证书使用查证). Remote opening for a newly formed WFOE is not permitted under PBOC account-opening rules, although post-activation treasury operations — payments, FX conversion, and hedging — can be executed through the bank's licensed electronic banking channels with digital certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) opacity through the Taiwan corporate chain; banks decline where the natural-person UBO cannot be identified.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial-ownership declaration (受益所有人信息申报表) signed by the legal representative; Taiwan company registration extract (经济部公司登记证明书) showing the full shareholder ladder; chain-of-ownership diagram down to natural persons; notarized and cross-strait-verified board resolution or shareholder register; EIA filing receipt (外商投资信息报告回执); passport copies of underlying individuals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds verification for the initial FDI capital injection from Taiwan; remittance by an unauthorised third party or substitution of intercompany loans triggers STR filing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital contribution resolution by the Taiwan shareholder; Taiwan MOEA Investment Commission approval/exemption documentation; 12 months of bank statements for the Taiwan remitting entity; source-of-wealth statement; subscription agreement with payment schedule; SWIFT field 70 confirmation quoting the SAFE FDI registration number.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering flags on matcha procurement: round-number invoicing, related-party price deviation (transfer pricing risk), mismatched Japan-Taiwan-China shipment routes, or customs value vs. payment value discrepancies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices and packing lists; bills of lading or air waybills; customs import/export declarations (报关单) tied to the payment; third-party quality certificates (JAS/USDA/EU Organic, pesticide-residue lab reports); supplier contracts with grade specifications; transfer-pricing documentation or a simplified cost-plus analysis for any related-party leg.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening hits on Taiwan-resident directors, the Taiwan parent, or the Japanese matcha-vendor counterparty.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Clean sanctions/adverse-media screening reports from a licensed vendor (e.g., Dow Jones, Refinitiv World-Check); PEP self-declaration; explainable source-of-wealth statement; statutory declaration of beneficial ownership; corporate charter and registry extracts confirming no sanctioned entity appears as a controller.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Single-product concentration in 'agricultural commodities' coupled with a cross-strait ownership chain; banks may demand enhanced due diligence before onboarding trade finance facilities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month procurement and sales forecast; supplier and buyer contracts with defined quality, grading, and delivery milestones; inspection certificates from SGS, Bureau Veritas, or Intertek per shipment; warehouse receipts; the WFOE's business license explicitly enumerating wholesale of packaged food (matcha powder) to demonstrate legislative consistency.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Taiwan parent executes SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's FDI Foreign-Currency Capital Account at the onshore bank, citing the SAFE FDI registration number and the SAFE '涉外收入申报单' purpose code 623 (Direct Investment) sub-category for paid-in registered capital; the receiving bank verifies the remitter against the registered shareholder list, confirms the amount against the business license registered capital, and applies capital-account settlement only upon presentation of genuine business-use documentation (wages, third-party trade payables, rent). Use of capital-account RMB proceeds for intercompany lending, equity investment in another Chinese entity, or non-operating expenditures is prohibited; early repatriation of capital before approved deregistration (减资/注销) requires SAFE-specific procedures and liquidation audit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails are (1) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer for open-account settlement of organic matcha powder purchases from Taiwanese or Japanese vendors, matched to invoices, packing lists, and customs import declarations in the Goods-Trade Foreign Exchange reporting system; (2) commercial letters of credit (MT700/MT707 issue/amendment, MT754 advice, MT740 reimbursement) for first-time or high-value vendor contracts, payable against clean bills of lading and organic-compliance documentation; and (3) CIPS RMB clearing as a lower-cost alternative where the counterparty is inside the RMB offshore corridor. Each outbound payment is screened against the 'real transaction background' requirement and the bank's annual Foreign Exchange Verification Report; trade-based money laundering controls require consistent commodity classification (HS 0902 matcha) and customs value alignment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore RMB FX forwards (远期结售汇) with tenors up to 12 months, executed with a licensed Chinese bank under the real-demand principle (实需原则) evidenced by the underlying matcha trade contracts and customs declarations.
FX swaps (外汇掉期) combining spot and forward CNY/USD or CNY/JPY legs for treasury liquidity smoothing on committed trade receivables and payables.
Cross-currency swaps (货币掉期) for medium-term CNY/USD/JPY interest-and-principal exchanges where the principal flows mirror the contracted trade settlement schedule of the matcha distribution business.
Onshore FX options (外汇期权) — vanilla calls/puts, collars, and risk reversals — written by a licensed bank on a trade-backed basis, with premiums paid in foreign currency.

Offshore USD/CNY or USD/TWD non-deliverable forwards (NDFs): generally not permissible for onshore resident entities because SAFE requires deliverable hedging with genuine transaction background; the WFOE executes synthetic TWD hedging by combining USD/CNY deliverable forwards with an onshore FX swap leg against the USD, which is the compliance-compatible substitute.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Report and Approved Financial Statements (年度業務報告書及財務報表)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce, Company Registration E-Service Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within 6 months after fiscal year-end (calendar-year WFOE: by 30 June); MOEA filing within 15 days after such approval (calendar-year WFOE: by mid-July)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Rectification order from MOEA; failure to file subjects the responsible person to fine of NT$10,000–NT$50,000 (approx. USD 320–1,600); continued non-compliance may trigger administrative strike-off or revocation of company registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Annual Operations Report (投資事業年度營運申報表)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Investment Review, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAID)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 6 months after fiscal year-end (calendar-year WFOE: by 30 June); no government filing fee for standard e-submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: MOEAID rectification order; false or delinquent reporting may result in administrative fines up to NT$300,000 (approx. USD 9,600) under the Administrative Penalty Act and, upon repeated default, revocation of the foreign-investment approval and forced deregistration of the WFOE

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Register of Controllers and Shareholders over 10% (實質受益人及股東申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Central Company Registration Information Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation filed together with the annual business report (calendar-year WFOE: by 30 June); any change in 10%+ shareholding or ultimate beneficial ownership reported within 15 days of the triggering event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of NT$60,000–NT$300,000 (approx. USD 1,920–9,600) on the responsible person for omission or false declaration; per-incident penalties for repeated non-compliance and potential administrative strike-off of the registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報書), including audited financial statements where the CPA threshold applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (local branch with jurisdiction over the WFOE's registration address)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May of the year following the closed calendar fiscal year; one-month extension available for electronic filing with proper application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 3% of assessed tax for each month overdue, capped at 10%; late-payment surcharge of 1% for every two days, capped at 15%; after a demand notice, the tax authority may assess the tax by available information and impose additional fines

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory CPA audit and attestation where paid-in capital exceeds NT$30 million (approx. USD 1.0 million) pursuant to Companies Act Article 20; also mandatory for entities treated as public companies or specifically designated by the central competent authority. The matcha-trading WFOE below the threshold may submit self-prepared statements with regular bookkeeping certification.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: ROC GAAP under the Business Entity Accounting Act (商業會計法) and associated standards for non-public WFOEs; IFRS/TIFRS apply if the company is FSC-regulated or reaches public-company scale.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Companies Act Article 22-1, the WFOE must maintain and annually confirm a register identifying every shareholder holding 10% or more and all ultimate beneficial owners; the register is locked as of the fiscal year-end, must be amended within 15 days of any share transfer or control change, and the annual confirmation is filed with MOEA together with the annual business report. The responsible person must certify the accuracy of the data under statutory penalty for false or incomplete disclosure.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders' ledger recording transfers and beneficial holders)
Register of Directors (including appointment and resignation records)
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings and Board Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500–6,000 per annum (standard local corporate secretarial and registered-office agent services in Taipei, Taichung, or Kaohsiung)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000–12,000 (typical CPA audit and attestation fee for a mid-sized matcha trading WFOE; reduced bookkeeping-only packages USD 1,500–3,500 if no compulsory audit applies)
